FileUploadBundleConfig.description:
Standalone multi-file bundle upload tool configuration
(`[file_upload_bundle]`).

When `url` is set to a non-empty value, registers a `file_upload_bundle`
tool that POSTs N files from the agent's local filesystem to the
configured endpoint as a single `multipart/form-data` request. The LLM
provides only file paths; the host reads the bytes.

When `url` is `None` or empty, the tool is not registered.

field_name.description: Multipart form-field name reused across every file part. Default: `file`.

headers.description: Static HTTP headers attached to every upload request.

max_file_size_bytes.description: Maximum per-file size in bytes. Default: 10 MiB.

max_files.description: Maximum number of files per call. Default: 16.

max_response_body_bytes.description:
Maximum response body bytes to read from the upload endpoint.
Prevents unbounded memory use from a malicious or verbose receiver.
Default: 4096 (4 KiB).

max_total_size_bytes.description: Maximum cumulative size across every file in one call. Default: 32 MiB.

method.description: HTTP method. Only `POST` (default) and `PUT` are accepted.

url.description: Upload endpoint URL. Tool is disabled when this is `None` or empty.
